subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed report remain the coordination issue for both delivery-mirror side-branch poisoning and empty signed Anthropic thinking replay, or should maintainers split it across the narrower open issue and PR paths?
rationale: The remaining work spans separate but interacting transcript-replay paths with open candidate PRs, and choosing the canonical tracking shape is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a safe new repair job.

options.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror and Anthropic replay PRs, then close it only when both failure classes have current-main proof.

options.title: Split Canonical Tracking
options.body: Move the thinking-signature follow-up to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92201 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and keep this issue focused on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Wait For Fixture
options.body: Ask the reporter for sanitized JSONL/log excerpts before deciding whether the delivery-mirror half is still reproducible on current main.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror and Anthropic replay PRs, then close it only when both failure classes have current-main proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the affected Anthropic/provider transport surface and is the best available routing candidate for the cross-PR policy decision.
